title: MoMentNu
excerpt: Video and projections for MoMentNu, an immersive light installation with artist Willem Geerts.
description:
MoMentNu is an installation at Museum Jan Cunen in Oss, based on a concept by artist Willem Geerts. I made all of it: the video, the projections and the build in the space. Horizontal bands of moving light are wrapped around the wooden beams and pillars of the space, turning the architecture itself into a slow, drifting landscape of projected image.
> Visitors move through the darkened room as the projections shift around them, blurring the line between the building and the picture. A quiet, immersive meditation on the present moment.
credits: Concept: Willem Geerts. Realisation, video & projections: Jaco Schilp / Studio Schilp. Presented at Museum Jan Cunen, Oss.
